_comment: Facets are what makes one branch of a chain different from the next one. The category tree answers 'what kind of place is this'; facets answer 'is it worth walking to THAT one'. Order = display order, on the place page and in the filter-chip row. 'auto' names the importer rule that can fill it without asking a human — everything else waits for someone standing at the door. A facet with no evidence renders as nothing at all: absent is not the same as false, and a directory that guesses 'no ATM' is worse than one that says nothing.
_applies_note: appliesTo matches record.sub, appliesToCat matches record.cat, and a record takes the FIRST set that claims one of its subs before any set that claims one of its cats — the more specific claim wins. Convenience stores came first because that is where the question was loudest — 386 7-Elevens with identical records — but nothing there is 7-Eleven-specific and the same row will serve pharmacies and fuel stations when their turn comes. appliesToCat was added 2026-08-17 for massage, where sub-matching alone could not work: OSM records a massage shop as shop=massage and stops, so 237 of 294 records carry no sub at all, and a sub-only rule would have made the facet row reachable only for shops that had already been sorted into a modality — while the door survey that assigns the modality is the same visit that would tick the facets. Any category whose crawl yields no subs had the same hole; this closes it for all of them.
_toilet_note: The toilet question is asked twice over, in two different senses, and they must not be confused. On a convenience store `toilet` carries auto_means_near and means 'there is one around here' — a spatial join to a mapped point 30 m away, which is evidence about the street, not about the shop. On a sit-down place `toilethere` means what it says: somebody used the one inside. Thai convenience stores do not normally keep a customer toilet, which is why they get the weaker sentence and no tier on /toilets.html. The sit-down set exists because the toilet question was never asked of 4,153 food records and 398 bars at all — appliesTo listed only 'convenience', so the loudest 'may I use yours' in the city went unrecorded. `toiletnone` is the one facet on this site that records an absence: a person who stood at the door and found nothing is giving testimony, not inferring, and it is the only way a wrong guess comes off the toilets page.

sets.note_en: Two hair shops in one soi are not the same shop. One does digital perms; the next has never touched tightly coiled hair. One braids; the next only does extensions. One finishes with a straight razor; the next owns clippers and nothing else. None of it is in OpenStreetMap — of the 371 hairdresser and beauty points across both provinces, not one carries a tag saying what the shop can actually do. These are the questions somebody walking in actually asks. The ants write down what the shop answers, with a source; an owner can tick their own. A blank is silence, never a no.

sets.note_en: Two buildings in one soi are not the same building. One posts a fair per-unit electric rate; the next charges double. One room comes furnished; the next is bare concrete. One takes a cat; the next never will. None of it is on any map — of the 322 residential records across both provinces, OpenStreetMap knows the floor count of 77, a phone for 41, and the electric rate, the deposit or the pet rule of none. These are the questions people actually ask at the desk. The ants write down what the building answers, with a source; an owner can tick their own. A blank is silence, never a no.

_massage_note:
The massage set carries two of the three axes from notes/massage-granularity-proposal-2026-08-17.md. The category tree is Axis 1, what the hands do. Here, in order: Axis 2 is the FRAME — what you take off, what you lie on, who else is in the room, whether the price is on a board outside. Axis 3 is the REGISTER — who says so: the numbered สบส. certificate under the Health Establishment Act B.E. 2559, a licensed Thai-traditional-medicine clinic, a practitioner's own professional licence, and who runs the place. Together they answer the question a reader is actually asking without anyone having to characterise a business or the people working in it.

TWO THINGS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and both should stay absent.

First, there is no 'no certificate seen' facet, even though toiletnone sets a precedent for recording an absence. A toilet is either there or it is not, and a passer-by who looked is giving testimony. A licence is different: it may be behind the counter, in an office, in a frame a customer never walks past — so 'none seen' is not testimony, it is one person's afternoon, and attached to a named business it does real harm while being easy to get wrong. hsscert is a positive fact or it is nothing.

Second, nothing here records who stands outside, how the signage looks, how late it opens, or anything else a reader might read as a hint about what a shop 'really' sells. The touching-tout signal that prompted this is on the printed reader sheet as guidance about street behaviour, which is fair and useful, and it is not a field on anybody's listing. Closing time is already plain fact in record.hours and needs no facet to carry an insinuation.
_cannabis_note: The cannabis row asks what the crawl cannot answer. OSM says a shop exists and sometimes when it opens; it never says whether the price is on the wall, whether you can sit down, or whether anyone behind the counter can tell you what you are buying — and those are the whole difference between two doors on the same soi. price-shown is deliberately first among the asked ones: asking whether something is แพง is ordinary Thai conversation, and a shop that posts its ฿/gram has already answered it. Nothing here is ever inferred from category — a shop is not assumed to allow smoking because it is a dispensary, and kratom-drink stays absent until somebody has actually seen the jug.
_medical_note: The medical row asks what a crawl cannot answer and what matters most when you are ill. บัตรทอง and ประกันสังคม decide whether a visit costs nothing or costs a week's wages, and no directory of this city states them. NOTHING HERE IS EVER INFERRED FROM CATEGORY: a state hospital is not assumed to take the gold card, a private clinic is not assumed to refuse it, and an absent facet means nobody has asked — never that the answer is no. That rule matters more on this shelf than on any other, because a wrong 'no' here sends a sick person to the wrong door, or stops them going at all. คำเมือง is asked alongside English and Chinese on purpose: an elderly patient in Mae Chan being seen by a Bangkok-trained doctor has a language problem too, and it is never the one a farang directory records.
_school_note: The school row asks what a crawl cannot answer and what a parent asks first. NOTHING HERE IS EVER INFERRED FROM CATEGORY OR NAME: an international school is not assumed to teach in English, a government school is not assumed to lack an EP stream, and a school with no ticks has not been asked — it has not answered no. A wrong 'no' here costs a child a place. ค่าเทอม is asked because asking whether a thing is แพง is ordinary talk and hiding the price serves nobody; ED visa and drop-in are asked because a language school or a ค่ายมวย lives or dies on them, and no directory of this city records either.
_muaythai_note: The muay thai row asks what a crawl cannot answer and what a person about to walk into a camp or a stadium asks first. NOTHING HERE IS EVER INFERRED FROM NAME OR SHELF: a gym called Fitness & Boxing is not assumed to take beginners, a camp with fighters on the cards is not assumed to refuse them, a stadium is not assumed to fight tonight, and a place with no ticks has not been asked — it has not answered no. Fight nights, prices and drop-in rules are the venue's own statement (attrs on the record, data/curated/fight_nights.json) or nothing. The set sits BEFORE the school set on purpose: the school set claims sub `muaythai`, and a camp should meet these questions rather than the school bus and the lunch.
_cooking_note: The cooking row asks what a crawl cannot answer and what a person about to book a class asks first. NOTHING HERE IS EVER INFERRED FROM NAME OR SHELF: a school on the farm shelf is not assumed to fetch you, a school whose site says vegan is not ticked vegan until somebody at the door or the owner says so, and a school with no ticks has not been asked — it has not answered no. Sessions, prices and pickup radius are the school's own statements (attrs on the record via enrich.json, data/curated/cooking_classes.json) or nothing. The two licence facets are paperwork, photographable, and positive only: a โรงเรียนนอกระบบ registered with สช. under the Private School Act B.E. 2550 hangs a numbered licence and can issue a Ministry-recognised certificate; a class that fetches you and walks a market may be registered instead as a tour business with a TAT licence number (Suwannee in Chiang Rai prints hers). Neither absence is recorded — a licence can sit behind a counter — and neither is a judgement: a kitchen is a kitchen. The set sits BEFORE the school set on purpose: the school set claims sub `cooking`, and a cooking school should meet these questions rather than the school bus and the lunch.
_chang_note: The elephant row asks what a crawl cannot answer and what a person about to book a day with elephants asks first — and it is asked, never inferred. NOTHING HERE IS TICKED FROM A NAME, A SHELF OR A WEBSITE: a place called Sanctuary is not assumed to refuse riding, a place called Camp is not assumed to offer it, a place that says ethical is not assumed anything. What a venue states on its own page lives on the record as attrs.ridingStated / elephantProgram / elephantsStated (with programVia and a date) and on the board in data/curated/elephants.json with stated_by and fetched; a tick is the owner's or the door survey's. No welfare score, no ethical/unethical sort, ever — a wrong 'unethical' is a slur on a named family's camp at this site's scale, a wrong 'ethical' sends a reader somewhere under false comfort, and both are statements about a named business. The set sits after cooking and before school; no other set claims its subs.
_realestate_note: The realestate row asks what the crawl cannot answer and what decides whether a person takes the room. OSM sometimes knows the floor count and nothing else; the per-unit electric rate (ค่าไฟหน่วยละ) moves the real monthly cost more than the rent line does, and no map anywhere records it. Every key is a policy the building itself states — never an inference from its name or its price. The one number this set deliberately refuses: the foreign quota remaining in a condominium. It lives at the juristic office and changes with every transfer, so it may appear in data/curated/realestate.json only as a dated statement from the building's own channel — a facet tick would rot into a lie the week after it was true.
